evidence.claim: ZOOMLION dal 1992 produce macchine per costruzioni, minerarie e agricole, con 15 categorie di prodotto e 26 parchi industriali in Cina e 11 basi all'estero.
evidence.quote: Founded in 1992, ZOOMLION specializes in construction machinery, mining machinery, and agricultural machinery, with a product portfolio spanning 15 major categories, 78 product series, and 713 models. || It currently operates 26 industrial parks in China and 11 R&D and manufacturing bases overseas.
